title: Deferral: socket_sendmsg returns success without sending
notes: VERIFIED: tests/p3/t07_defer.sh, 9 assertions incl. a CONTROL case. Agent sendto() reports SUCCESS, packet never reaches the peer, WAL records it deferred. MUST be tcx/egress: cgroup_skb/egress drops but returns -EPERM to the sender, defeating the point.

title: Flush on commit / discard on abort with correct ordering
notes: VERIFIED: tests/p3/t08_flush.sh, 9 assertions. The same send arrives IFF the transaction commits. Replay is userspace (BPF maps are userspace-managed; building sk_buffs in-kernel buys nothing). ORDER: clear suppression BEFORE replay, or our own egress rule drops the replay and commit is a silent no-op.
